def _eq(attrs, key, value):
    return attrs.get(key) == value


def _le(attrs, key, bound):
    value = attrs.get(key)
    return isinstance(value, (int, float)) and value <= bound


def _ge(attrs, key, bound):
    value = attrs.get(key)
    return isinstance(value, (int, float)) and value >= bound
